title: Migrate Agent List writes to operation-backend

input.requestedOutcome: Replace sb_agents browser-local persistence with operation-backend Agents API integration in operations mode.
acceptanceCriteria: Create, edit, programs, rate type, table, delete, and lifecycle routes use documented API contracts.
Failed writes do not update the local projection or localStorage.
Legacy mode and classic-script ordering remain unchanged.
Focused UI and backend checks are recorded.
constraints: No backend, database, migration, mapping, or schema changes.
Use laOps/laOpsFetch rather than direct fetch.
Preserve legacy mode and server-first semantics.
Do not modify shared legacy renderer files or excluded parity files.
assumptions: 10-ops-catalogue.js loads after the adapter and can retain summary catalogue behavior.
Backend routes are the contracts in sales-editing.ts, agent-writes.ts, and agents.ts.

output.summary: Added an operations-only Agent adapter with authoritative detail/activity hydration, server-first create/edit/table/bulk/delete flows, lifecycle helpers, nested snake-case mapping, and visible errors; legacy functions remain the fallback.

filesChanged.purpose: Load the S1 classic adapter after ops core and before catalogue wrappers.
Map Agent UI projections and mutations to operation-backend routes in operations mode.
Focused controllable-API UI test for pending, successful, and failed Agent writes.
Durable S1 implementation and verification report.

behaviorChanges.before: Operations mode used catalogue summaries and a former read-only/detail wrapper.
behaviorChanges.after: The adapter fetches full Agent detail and activity and replaces the legacy projection from server data.

behaviorChanges.before: Operations mode blocked writes or could fall back to local persistence.
behaviorChanges.after: Operations-mode writes use POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE operation-backend routes and update memory only after success.

behaviorChanges.before: lk-inbox used the original local persistence functions.
behaviorChanges.after: The adapter delegates to original functions whenever operations mode is disabled.

changed: legacy Agent shape ↔ snake/nested Agent API mapping

details: Operations-mode SB_AGENTS projection is updated only from API responses.
Operations-mode sbAgentsPersist/agTblPersist are suppressed to prevent localStorage becoming authoritative.
Failed operations leave the local projection unchanged.

verification.evidence: 0 adapter failures; pending create, payload mapping, successful projection, edit, and failed edit checks passed.
Existing broader ops smoke failed boat/calendar/lock and booking fixture assertions; no S1 adapter assertion failed.

verification.command: npm run test:aginfo && npm run test:aghd
verification.evidence: Static harness login modal intercepted clicks in this environment.

decisions: Load S1 before 10-ops-catalogue.js so catalogue's former Agent read-only wrappers do not override S1 write wrappers.
Refuse import visibly in operations mode because no verified bulk import endpoint exists.
Retry rate-type changes with drop_unpriced only after the server returns that specific conflict and the user confirms.
risks: Bulk requests can partially succeed before a later request fails; each successful response is reconciled and the failure is surfaced.
Lifecycle commands are exposed as helpers but have no new UI button yet.
followUps: If required by product, attach Agent activate/deactivate/renew helpers to a future UI control.
rollback: Revert the S1 commit or remove the S1 script tag and adapter/test/report files; do not issue destructive API calls during rollback.
